351117: Allen lives in a small, nameless pioneer village. His status is serf. Although he is ostensibly without talent, he actually has the world's only "Summoner" class.
369796: The willful young heiress of the Granvelle family, who own and lord over Allen's hometown. Her class is "Wizardess". She usually plays the role of a graceful daughter to her family, but shows her selfish side to her closest friends.
369797: A serf girl with an innocent personality. Her natural class is "Sword Lord" - while her skills with swordplay already outpaced an adult's when she was five years old, she'd not good with using her head. Loves to fight and plays knights with her childhood friend Allen.
369798: The son of an arms dealer in Granvelle Village, Dogora is considered the bratty general of the kids there. He has a competitive personality and wears his heart on his sleeve. His natural talent is wielding axes. He loves to tease Allen, who he considers lower than himself.
381983: Allen's younger brother. His name has the meaning of "so that you will grow up to be a child who runs around freely". He became interested in spears after watching Allen and his friends play knights.
381984: The mother of Allen. She raises her children with a lot of love. She does not disown Allen, who is judged to have no talent, but accepts him gently.
381985: The father of Allen. Contrary to his wild appearance, he has a kind heart. He cares about his family very much. Besides, that, he's a hard worker. He is a serf in the pioneering village and plays an active role when hunting the demonic beast Boa.
381986: The head of the Granvelle family that rules over Allen's hometown and the surrounding areas
381987: Second son of the Granvelle family. Has a little selfish personality. He is the only one of his siblings who does not have talent.
381988: The eldest son of the Granvelle family. He is skilled in swordsmanship but is also a humble and gentle person who never shows off his skills to those around him.
